recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中 7 號位置只剩一條染色體，箭頭指向缺失的另一條，其餘染色體與性染色體 XY 皆成對正常，判讀為 45,XY,-7（單體 7），屬於定義 AML-MRC 的骨髓發育不良相關細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyotype with male sex chromosome complement (X and Y)
Only one chromosome 7 present; arrow marks the position of the missing homolog
All other autosomes present in pairs without visible structural rearrangement
describe_en: G-banded karyotype from a single metaphase shows a male complement with loss of one chromosome 7, indicated by the arrow, and no other apparent numeric or structural abnormalities. The karyotype is interpreted as 45,XY,-7. Monosomy 7 is a myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic abnormality that, in the presence of 20% or more blasts, qualifies for acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes and confers adverse risk; confirmation across multiple metaphases is required to call a clone.

ddx.vs: Deletion of 7q retains a shortened chromosome 7, whereas here the entire homolog is absent.

ddx.dx: Random chromosome loss from metaphase preparation
ddx.vs: A single missing chromosome may be a technical artifact; by ISCN, loss must be seen in at least three metaphases to define a clone.
Morphology and karyotype cannot distinguish these; young age, family history, and germline testing are required.
